name: Diao Chan
subtitle: Sable Lady
lore: Once a courtesan and adroit politician, Diao Chan shaped history by turning ambitious leaders such as Lu Bu against one another. Over time, however, she has grown tired of such indirect methods. Now she uses her skills to infiltrate and assassinate, gradually molding the mortal governments of Tian—though to what precise end, or on whose behalf, are secrets she holds close.
